algorithm: Hierarchical clipped PPO, Monte-Carlo terminal returns, Huber critic, initial-policy KL anchor
game: 6-Max NLHE, 100 BB per hand, fixed 0.5/1 BB blinds, no rake
reward: Net payoff in BB / 100, gamma=1. No win/loss labels and no future cards in observations.
league: 50% six-seat current self-play; 50% one learner vs initial models / past checkpoints
evaluation: Frozen original panel, independent development and test chance seeds; no online replacement
